projects.name: AI4Bharat Website
projects.description: Interactive web platform for AI4Bharat, IIT Madras research lab building open-source AI for Indian languages, featuring live model demos.
projects.longDescription: Built a responsive web application with interactive UI components enabling users to interact with ML models across Transliteration, Machine Translation, ASR, TTS, and LLM categories. Implemented RESTful API integrations for real-time model inference and dynamic result rendering.
